title: 🖼️ Samsung Gallery App Connects to Google Photos Directly Before OneDrive Sync Ends!
body: 🖼️ Samsung Gallery App Connects to Google Photos Directly Before OneDrive Sync Ends!

Samsung began rolling out a new integration between the “Samsung Gallery” app and Google Photos, letting Galaxy users back up their photos and videos to Google’s cloud directly from inside the Gallery app. A “Sync photos and videos” option appeared in app version 15.9.01.7, and the integration comes before Samsung’s partnership with Microsoft for syncing photos through OneDrive ends on September 30.
Simply put: instead of backing up your photos to OneDrive, you can now back them up to Google Photos from the same app, without opening another app.
Where do you back up your phone’s photos?
